text:
Decision by Matt Barge, 2026-09-25, relayed to the Claude Code session building the alpha-website-playbook QC cadence branch:

Filer cadence: change .github/workflows/observer-filer.yml from the hourly cron to workflow_run on the aeo site-observe.yml workflow completing with conclusion success (cross-repo workflow_run is not supported, so implement it as a repository_dispatch receiver with event type observer-run-completed carrying the run id, plus a fallback cron at 06:45 and 21:45 UTC that uses the freshness gate already in place), and set clearAfterRuns semantics in the runbook to "two consecutive full runs, about one day". Keep OBSERVER_FILER_APPLY gating and the freshness gate unchanged.

Docs: a "Cadence, breadth and depth" section in docs/sweep-runbook.md with the table (full render twice a day at 06:00 and 21:00 UTC, events every two hours, source contracts daily at 06:30 UTC to the source digest, loop health every run, filer after each full run, agent sweep every two or three days, change triggers via repository_dispatch).
